```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Modify patient ID
patient_id <- function(pid) {
  m <- str_match(pid, "^CAR-(\\d+)$")
  n <- as.integer(m[,2])
  ifelse(!is.na(n),
         paste("CAR", n, sep = "-"),
         NA_character_)
}

# load miRNA normalized expression
cart_mat <- read_xlsx("CAR_T_microRNA_expr_matrix.xlsx",
               sheet = "Normalizedcounts_deseq2"
)
cart_mat$miRNA <- gsub("-", "_", cart_mat$miRNA)
cart_mat$miRNA <- gsub("/", "_", cart_mat$miRNA)

cart_id <- patient_id(colnames(cart_mat))
cart_id <- c(colnames(cart_mat)[1], cart_id[-1])
colnames(cart_mat) <- cart_id

cart_mat <- as.data.frame(cart_mat)
rownames(cart_mat) <- cart_mat$miRNA
cart_mat$miRNA <- NULL

# micro-RNA filtering
# Every microRNA with 6 (10%) patients more zeroes is removed
cart_microRNA <- cart_mat[rowSums(cart_mat==0) < 6, ]
dim(cart_microRNA)

cart_microRNA <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(cart_microRNA)))
cart_microRNA <- cart_microRNA[order(rownames(cart_microRNA)), ]

# Clinical variables
clinic_cov <- read_xlsx("clinical_covariates.xlsx")
dim(clinic_cov)
# remove unused variables
clinic_cov <- clinic_cov[, -c(16, 23:24, 26:34)]
clinic_cov <- as.data.frame(clinic_cov)
colnames(clinic_cov) <- c("patient_id","sex",
                    "age60","histology",
                    "n_lines_preAferesi","pre_aferesi_status","bridge_infusion",
                    "PET_BRIDGING","ECOG_PRELD","stage",
                    "BULKY_PRELD","DLBCL_R_IPI_PRELD","MCL_MIPI_PRELD","CAR_T_type",
                    "CAR_T_PRODUCT", "CRS","ICANS","ICANS_ricat","LDH_PRELD",
                    "FERR_PRELD","PCR_PRELD","follow_3months","pfs_status" ,"pfs_time" )
clinic_cov$follow_3months <- as.numeric(clinic_cov$follow_3months)

clinic_cov$patient_id <- patient_id(clinic_cov$patient_id)
clinic_cov <- clinic_cov[order(clinic_cov$patient_id), ]
# sex F = 1, M = 0
clinic_cov$sex[clinic_cov$sex=="F"] <- "1"
clinic_cov$sex[clinic_cov$sex=="M"] <- "0"
# histology PMBCL = 0, LBCL = 1, MCL = 2
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="PMBCL"] <- "0"
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="LBCL"] <- "1"
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="MCL"] <- "2"
clinic_cov$histology <- as.numeric(clinic_cov$histology)
```

# Follow up 3 months (CR/PR vs SD/PD)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# remove NA 
fll_up3 <- clinic_cov[!is.na(clinic_cov$follow_3months),]
# remove MCL
fll_up3 <- fll_up3[fll_up3$histology!= "MCL", ]
# remove cov that have NA
fll_up3 <- fll_up3[, -c(8,12:14, 23, 24)]
fll_up3 <- fll_up3[fll_up3$BULKY_PRELD!="ND",]
#fll_up3$ICANS_ricat <- NULL
dim(fll_up3)

fll_up3$ICANS <- NULL
fll_up3$follow_3months <- NULL

cart_fllup3 <- cart_microRNA[rownames(cart_microRNA) %in% fll_up3$patient_id, ]
cart_fllup3 <- cbind(fll_up3, cart_fllup3)
cart_fllup3$ICANS <- NULL

cart_fllup3 <- cart_microRNA[rownames(cart_microRNA) %in% fll_up3$patient_id, ]
cart_fllup3 <- cbind(fll_up3, cart_fllup3)
dim(cart_fllup3)
cart_fllup3$ICANS <- NULL
cart_fllup3$fll3_cart <- paste(cart_fllup3$CAR_T_PRODUCT, cart_fllup3$follow_3months, sep = "_")
cart_fllup3$fll3_cart[cart_fllup3$fll3_cart=="1_0"] <- "cart1_0"
cart_fllup3$fll3_cart[cart_fllup3$fll3_cart=="0_0"] <- "cart0_0"
cart_fllup3$fll3_cart[cart_fllup3$fll3_cart=="0_1"] <- "cart0_1"
cart_fllup3$fll3_cart[cart_fllup3$fll3_cart=="1_1"] <- "cart1_1"
```

# Train/Validation/Test sets

```{r, eval=FALSE}
split <- function(data) {
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(y = data$fll3_cart, p = .75, list = FALSE)
  ll <- list(discovery = data[inTrain, ], test = data[-inTrain, ])
  return(ll)
}

train_valid <- function(discovery){ 
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(y = discovery$fll3_cart, p = .75, list = FALSE)
  train <- discovery[inTrain, ]
  train$patient_id <- NULL
  train$fll3_cart <- NULL
  
  valid <- discovery[-inTrain,]
  valid$patient_id <- NULL
  valid$fll3_cart <- NULL

  ll <- list(train = train, valid = valid)
  return(ll)
}

set.seed(333)
split1 <- split(cart_fllup3)

split2 <- replicate(10, train_valid(split1$discovery), simplify = FALSE)
train <- lapply(1:10, function(i) split2[[i]][[1]])
valid <- lapply(1:10, function(i) split2[[i]][[2]])
```

# Elastic net

```{r, eval=FALSE}
set.seed(333)
foldid <- sample(rep(seq(5), length.out = nrow(train[[1]][,-16])))
elastic_net <- function(train, foldid) {
  cv <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(train[, -16]), train[, 16], family =  "binomial", foldid = foldid, alpha = 0.3)
  return(cv)
}

cv_glmnet <- lapply(train, function(x) elastic_net(x, foldid))
```

```{r}
accuracy_dist <- function(cv_glmnet, valid) {
  pred <- as.data.frame(predict(cv_glmnet, newx = as.matrix(valid[, -16]), type = "response", s = "lambda.min"))
  pred$lambda.min[pred$lambda.min >= 0.5] <- 1
  pred$lambda.min[pred$lambda.min < 0.5] <- 0
  
  y_real <- valid$follow_3months
  y_pred <- pred$lambda.min
  
  tab <- table(factor(y_real, levels= 0:1), factor(y_pred, levels= 0:1))
  accuracy <- (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2]) / (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2] + tab[1, 2] + tab[2, 1]) 
  return(accuracy)
}

valid_accuracy <- mapply(function(x, y) accuracy_dist(cv_glmnet = x, y),
                         cv_glmnet, valid)
summary(valid_accuracy)
hist(valid_accuracy)
```

```{r}
coef_ll <- function(cv_glmnet) {
  coef <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(cv_glmnet, s = "lambda.min")))
  coef$var <- rownames(coef)
  coef <- coef[abs(coef$s1) > 0, ]
  coef <- coef[-1, ]
  coef <- as.data.frame(coef$var)
  return(coef)
}
df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, lapply(cv_glmnet, function(x) coef_ll(x))))
df <- as.data.frame(table(df))
df <- df[order(df$Freq, decreasing = TRUE ), ]
colnames(df) <- c("var", "times")
df$freq <- 100*round(df$times/length(cv_glmnet), 2)
df$type <- as.character(df$var)
df$type[grep("hsa", df$var)] <- "mirna"
df$type[df$type != "mirna"] <- "clinic"
df <- df[df$times>=10,]

ggplot(df, aes(x=reorder(var, freq, decreasing = TRUE), y=freq, fill=type)) + geom_col(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0)) + ylim(0,100) + labs(x=NULL) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90), text=element_text(size=5))

ggplot(df[df$freq>=50,], aes(x=reorder(var, freq, decreasing = TRUE), y=freq, fill=type)) + geom_col(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0)) + ylim(0,100) + labs(x=NULL) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90), text=element_text(size=15))
```

# Final model

```{r}
df <- df[df$freq >= 50, ]
df$var <- as.character(df$var)

ggplot(df, aes(x=reorder(var, freq, decreasing = TRUE), y = freq, fill = type)) + 
  geom_col(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0)) + ylim(0, 100) + labs(x = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90), text=element_text(size = 5))

discovery_slc <- discovery[, c("follow_3months", df[1:5,]$var)]

fit_glm <- glm(follow_3months ~., data = discovery_slc, family = "binomial")
summary(fit_glm)  

test$patient_id <- NULL
y_real <- test$follow_3months
y_pred <- round(predict(fit_glm, newdata = test[,-c(16)], type = "response"))

tab <- table(factor(y_real, levels= 0:1), factor(y_pred, levels= 0:1))
accuracy <- (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2]) / (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2] + tab[1, 2] + tab[2, 1]) 
accuracy
```
